vnodes.title: CockroachDB RLS: GA since 25.2, pitched for agent access in v26.1; ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING skips RLS check on the VALUES row
vnodes.summary: Verifier-found extra native-RLS bypass beyond the explorer list (CDC, backup/restore, LDR/PCR, cascades). Reinforces: native RLS is necessary, not sufficient; keep the in-server IR check.

vnodes.title: MongoBleed CVE-2025-14847: exploited in the wild, ~87k exposed, zlib on by default, no patch for 3.6/4.0/4.2
vnodes.summary: Fixed in 4.4.30/5.0.32/6.0.27/7.0.28/8.0.17/8.2.3. A PEP/adapter must not assume a patched backend: disable wire compression from the adapter side and gate on server version at connect.

vnodes.title: CRA Implementing Regulation (EU) 2025/2392 (adopted 2025-11-28) defines the Annex III category descriptions; Art 7 classifies by primary function
vnodes.summary: Controlling text for class I/II placement; an optional rate limiter in a general web server is unlikely to make the product a class II firewall. Draft standard prEN 304636 scopes firewalls as network/host products.

vnodes.title: CRA draft guidance (consultation 2026-03-03..31): monetizing services around free software can make it a commercial activity (manufacturer)
vnodes.summary: Responsibility follows who publishes and controls the project. A paid support/hosting offering around the golden turns the distributor into a manufacturer with Art14 reporting and conformity assessment. The claimed C(2026)5252 (2026-07-27) id was not verifiable.

vnodes.title: aws-lc-rs FIPS module-to-crate map: 3.0.x -> aws-lc-rs <1.18.0; 1.17.4 uses fips-sys 0.13.17 on v3.6.0 source; 1.18.x on FIPS 4.x snapshot
vnodes.summary: README warns fips-sys tracks the latest module that completed testing, so exact-version pins are mandatory; v1.18.0 notes tell FIPS users to pin <1.18.0. Which crate version is byte-identical to CMVP #5298/#5314 is unproven (explorer proposes 1.15.3/0.13.11). CMVP #5429 (AWS-LC dynamic, 2026-07-20, sunset 2029-08-13) is a newer validated entry with unknown coverage.

vnodes.title: curl CURL-CVE-2026-9545: HTTP/3 early data sent to an impostor server via cached session
vnodes.summary: Client-side 0-RTT cross-request-state failure: cached session plus early data enabled leaks request bytes before authentication completes. Evidence for CRS C2/C4 (scope and freshness) on the upstream-client side of a gateway.

vnodes.title: curl 2026 credential-bound state outliving its principal: Digest cross-origin/proxy (11856, 7168, 8927), netrc on reused proxy (6429), Negotiate reuse (5545, 1965, 19931, 87861), client-cert reuse (86415, 86411), CA trust (11564), TLS requirement ignored on reuse (4873)
vnodes.summary: Broader than pool-key omissions: auth/verifier/policy config missing from the reuse key and auth state surviving origin change. Supports derive(Hash,Eq) over the whole upstream config and the epoch clause C5.

vnodes.title: Hebrok et al. USENIX Sec 2025 also show server-authentication bypass via shared STEKs across six provider clusters (incl. Fastly, DDoS-Guard, Variti)
vnodes.summary: Not only client-auth bypass: reverse-proxy-to-origin STEK sharing lets one origin impersonate another. Ticketers must be partitioned per cert chain and verifier on both sides.

vnodes.title: Docker mcp-gateway 2026 advisories beyond the corpus: SSRF via remote URL (CVE-2026-76093), file:// read (76095), tool-name shadowing (76097), bind mount via dynamic tools (76099), image signature verify off by default (76094), case-variant reserved names (GHSA-qg99), malformed resource URI crash (GHSA-jfp6)
vnodes.summary: Supports fail-closed-construction and namespace-collision invariants (canonical case-folded tool namespace per backend).

vnodes.title: agentgateway cross-namespace policy advisories (GHSA-g7j8-wp7h-wmgr 2026-09-02, GHSA-jwm2-83f3-52xc 2026-06-29): control-plane policy attachment is its own invariant
vnodes.summary: Data-plane invariant lists miss control-plane attachment: a policy/route from tenant A must not bind to tenant B backends without an explicit grant.

vnodes.title: rmcp advisories missed by corpus: custom headers leak on cross-origin redirect (GHSA-9g45, 2026-07-02), permanent session-table leak (GHSA-9pj6), unbounded tool_schemas cache (GHSA-4432, 2026-10-20), missing PRM resource validation (GHSA-33f5)
vnodes.summary: Redirect-strip and bounded-state cases for the conformance corpus; reinforces pin-and-re-audit per rmcp bump.

vnodes.title: HTTP/2 Bomb amplification ratios (Calif primary): nginx ~70:1, IIS ~68:1, Envoy ~5,700:1, Apache httpd ~4,000:1; only Apache got a CVE (CVE-2026-49975)
vnodes.summary: Corrects the map: CVE-2026-49975 is Apache mod_h2 only; Envoy fix is GHSA-22m2-hvr2-xqc8 (no CVE named in the post); nginx 1.29.8 added max_headers. Pingora ratio not given in the post.

vnodes.title: FedRAMP 20x Class A/B/C certification tiers and Security Decision Records shape what evidence a server project should emit
vnodes.summary: Secondary source reports 7/41/46 KSIs per class; rules JSON has 10 KSI groups and maps sc-13 directly in KSI-SVC indicators.
